mapper.sql: id, app_id AS appId, name, metric, op_type AS opType, threshold, window_minutes AS windowMinutes, platform, app_version AS appVersion, webhook, enabled, cooldown_minutes AS cooldownMinutes, last_trigger_time AS lastTriggerTime, trigger_count AS triggerCount, created_by AS createdBy, add_time AS addTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM logan_alert_rule WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_alert_rule (app_id, name, metric, op_type, threshold, window_minutes, platform, app_version, webhook, enabled, cooldown_minutes, created_by, add_time, update_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{name}, #{metric}, #{opType}, #{threshold}, #{windowMinutes}, #{platform}, #{appVersion}, #{webhook}, #{enabled}, #{cooldownMinutes}, #{createdBy}, #{addTime}, #{addTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE logan_alert_rule SET last_trigger_time=#{triggerTime}, trigger_count=trigger_count+1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_alert_record (rule_id, app_id, metric, value, threshold, window_begin, window_end, webhook_result, payload, add_time) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{appId}, #{metric}, #{value}, #{threshold}, #{windowBegin}, #{windowEnd}, #{webhookResult}, #{payload}, #{addTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logan_alert_record WHERE add_time >= #{beginTime} AND app_id=#{appId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logan_alert_rule WHERE enabled = 1 AND app_id=#{appId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM logan_alert_record WHERE add_time < #{cutoff} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE r FROM logan_alert_record r JOIN (SELECT id FROM logan_alert_record ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET #{keep}) t ON r.id <= t.id
